history.overview: The Quarries were once Dragorn excavation tunnels, later collapsed and corrupted by Discord.

timeline.name: Excavation Era
timeline.description: Dragorn miners carved tunnels to extract stone for ceremonial halls.

timeline.name: Muramite Invasion
timeline.description: Muramite forces invaded Dranik, causing tunnel collapses.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord fissures opened, warping the stone and animating the dead.

timeline.name: Resistance Recon
timeline.description: Dragorn resistance agents scouted the Quarries for infiltration routes.
